proposition: Aḥmad Samarqandī, once Khwāfī's chief disciple, received a copy of Ibn Turka's Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr (letter 13) and was disowned and persecuted by Khwāfī for teaching the Fuṣūṣ or reciting Qāsim-i Anvār's verse.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka to Aḥmad Samarqandī, letter 13

mediation.note: the persecution is MK repeating Bashir and Manz
